usage: deskops show [-h]
                    {task,pill,ritual,board,atom,materialization,repository,inbox-note,faq-doc,step} ...

positional arguments:
  {task,pill,ritual,board,atom,materialization,repository,inbox-note,faq-doc,step}
    task                Show one actionable task by selector.
    pill                Show one pill by selector.
    ritual              Show one ritual by selector.
    board               Show one board by selector.
    atom                Show one atom by selector.
    materialization     Show one materialization by selector.
    repository          Show one repository by selector.
    inbox-note          Show one inbox-note by selector.
    faq-doc             Show one faq-doc by selector.
    step                Show one step by selector.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops show task task-fix-thing --root .
  deskops show pill pill-keep-layers-clean --root .

Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.
